[last] Right—**collapse defines the group; indentation doesn’t.** I drew that incorrectly.

Inside an expanded group, show subgroups as **small muted labels**, aligned with the existing text column. Pane rows keep their current position.

```text
PANES

▾ ▣ agent-vm · ShravanSunder

    ACTIVE
  ◫ Pane 2 · agent-vm
  ▷ Latest terminal output…
  ⎇ main

    <10 MIN
  ◫ Pane 3 · zsh
  ▷ Latest terminal output…
  ⎇ oauth-post-merge

    LAST HOUR
  ◫ Pane 1 · agent-vm.review
  ▷ Latest terminal output…

▸ ▣ ai-tools · ShravanSunder
```

Here, repository names, subgroup labels, and pane text share the **same text column**; row icons share the existing icon column.

I recommend:

- **Repository/tab:** collapsible, as today.
- **Activity subgroup:** a quiet label plus vertical spacing, initially **not independently collapsible**.
- **No extra indentation, boxes, or separator lines.**
- Empty subgroups don’t appear.

That adds useful scanning breaks without making the sidebar a deeper tree. Collapsing the repository/tab hides all its subgroups and rows.
